_comment: Knowledge-audit allowlist. Names that legitimately never appear in the symbol index because they are not AOT metadata elements: X++ kernel (system) classes/enums shipped with the runtime rather than PackagesLocalDirectory, and .NET types reached through CLR interop. Every entry must state WHY. Fully-qualified System.* / Microsoft.* names are accepted without an entry. Do NOT add an entry to silence a defect — a hallucinated type is not a kernel type.
AccessType: X++ kernel enum — access level for SecurityRights checks.
CLRInterop: X++ kernel class — CLR interop helpers.
Connection: X++ kernel class — direct SQL (Connection/Statement/ResultSet trio).
DateTimeUtil: X++ kernel class (system runtime, no AOT metadata element).
DictClass: X++ kernel class — runtime reflection over a class (name/callObject/hasObjectMethod).
DictEnum: X++ kernel class — runtime reflection over an enum (symbol2Value/value2Symbol).
DictField: X++ kernel class — runtime reflection over a table field.
DictTable: X++ kernel class — runtime reflection over a table (fieldCnt/fieldCnt2Id/fieldName). Part of the Dict* reflection family, built into the runtime with no AOT metadata element; the FieldId entry below already refers to DictTable::fieldCnt2Id().
Exception: X++ kernel enum (Exception::Error / Info / Warning) — throw argument and infolog severity.
ExportAttribute: System.ComponentModel.Composition.ExportAttribute (MEF) — reached via `using`, not an AOT element.
FieldId: X++ kernel system type — field id returned by DictTable::fieldCnt2Id() (no AOT EDT element).
IFeatureMetadata: Microsoft.Dynamics.ApplicationPlatform.FeatureExposure.IFeatureMetadata — a .NET interface reached through CLR interop, written unqualified in X++ once the namespace is in scope. The AOT does carry IFeatureMetadataV0 and IFeatureMetadataEnablementNotifiable, but not this one: it is not an AOT element.
IO_Status: X++ kernel enum — file IO status.
InteropPermission: X++ kernel CAS permission class for CLR interop.
JoinMode: X++ kernel enum used by QueryBuildDataSource.joinMode().
List: X++ kernel class — collection (new List(Types::String)). The Types enum and ListEnumerator are already allowlisted here.
ListEnumerator: X++ kernel class — enumerator over List.
Map: X++ kernel class — collection (new Map(Types::Int64, Types::Class)).
MapEnumerator: X++ kernel class — enumerator over Map.
Query: X++ kernel class — runtime query object model.
QueryBuildDataSource: X++ kernel class — runtime query object model.
QueryBuildRange: X++ kernel class — runtime query object model.
QueryRun: X++ kernel class — runtime query object model.
RecordInsertList: X++ kernel class — buffered set-based insert.
RecordViewCache: X++ kernel class — in-memory pre-load of a record set (no AOT metadata element).
SecurityRights: X++ kernel class — runtime permission checks.
SetEnumerator: X++ kernel class — enumerator over Set.
Struct: X++ kernel class — named-field record collection (new Struct(), add/value/exists). Same family as List/Map/Set.
SysGlobalObjectCache: X++ kernel class — explicit cross-session server object cache (runtime, no AOT element).
Timezone: X++ kernel enum — time zone argument of the DateTimeUtil conversion methods.
Types: X++ kernel enum — element type passed to the collection constructors (Types::String, Types::Int64, …).
UnitOfWork: X++ kernel class — coordinated insert/update/delete commit in relation order.
ValidateEventArgs: X++ kernel event-args class for validate* event handlers.
xSession: X++ kernel class — runtime session info (xSession::currentRetryCount() etc.).
